name: Sarah Diodati Gardiner
bioAdditions: Daughter of John Lyon Gardiner, 7th Lord of the Manor of Gardiner's Island; wife of David Thompson (S1). She descends from the main Gardiner's Island line, not from Col. Abraham Gardiner and Mary Smith, so no Bull Smith descent is shown: an in-law. Her daughter Sarah G. Thompson married her cousin Col. David Lion Gardiner, Julia Tyler's brother (S1, S2).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 469-470
